C01.input: Read n, followed by n integers. Print the longest strictly increasing contiguous length.

C02.input: Read n and capacity, then n order sizes. Print accepted-count and remaining-capacity.

C03.input: Read q pairs of nonnegative integers. Print YES or NO for each pair.

C04.input: Read one complete line, preserving spaces. Print VALID or INVALID.

C05.input: Read n and target, then n integers. Print value and zero-based index; keep the earliest tie.

C06.input: Read L R a b. Print the sum of numbers divisible by exactly one divisor.

C07.input: Read n and n integers. Print the absolute difference of sums at even and odd indices.

C08.input: Read n and budget, then n prices. Print minimum-total and change, or IMPOSSIBLE.

C09.input: Read base1 numeral1, then base2 numeral2. Print LESS, EQUAL or GREATER. Values fit signed 64-bit.

C10.input: Read one complete label line. Print the normalized label, or EMPTY.

C11.input: Read a nonempty digit string. Print its weighted checksum modulo 10.

C12.input: Read nonnegative k on the first line and the complete text on the next line. Print the shifted text.

C13.input: Read q, then q commands (SET/ADD/SUB/MUL and an integer). Print the final accumulator.

C14.input: Read positive n. Print odd-part and exponent-of-two.

C15.input: Read n, followed by the n−1 supplied roll numbers. Print the missing number.

C16.input: Read r and c, then r rows of c integers. Print the earliest best-row index and row sum.

C17.input: Read one complete ASCII line. Print YES or NO after ignoring non-alphanumeric characters and case.

C18.input: Read n, then n coordinate pairs. Print total Manhattan distance including the return to the origin.

C19.input: Read n and n integers. Print second-distinct-maximum and frequency, or NONE.

C20.input: Read two digit strings on separate lines. Print MATCH or DIFFERENT; leading zeros count.

D01.input: Read divisor n, then range limit m. Print nondivisible-sum minus divisible-sum.

D02.input: Read n and n integers. Print the second-largest distinct value, or -1 if absent.

D03.input: Read a line of lowercase English letters. Print the number of distinct letters.

D04.input: Read one ASCII password line. Apply the classroom rule (at least 7 characters); print 1 or 0.

LC2894.input: Read range limit n, then divisor m (the reverse of D01). Print nondivisible-sum minus divisible-sum.

LC414.input: Read positive n and n integers. Print third-largest distinct value, or the maximum if fewer than three exist.

LC387.input: Read a lowercase English string. Print the zero-based index of its first unique character, or -1.

LC2299.input: Read an ASCII password line. Apply Strong Password Checker II rules and print true or false.

LC53.input: Read positive n and n integers. Print the maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray.

LC189.input: Read positive n and nonnegative k, then n integers. Print the array after rotating right by k.

LC49.input: Read n, then n lowercase English words, one per line (a word may be empty). Print groups as JSON arrays, ordered by sorted-letter key; retain input order inside each group.

LC3.input: Read one ASCII text line. Print the length of the longest substring without a repeated character.

LC12.input: Read an integer from 1 through 3999. Print its Roman numeral.

LC11.input: Read n (at least 2), then n nonnegative heights. Print maximum container area.

LC918.input: Read positive n and n integers. Print the maximum nonempty circular subarray sum.

F01.input: Read positive n and k (1 through n), then n integers. Print the maximum sum over exactly k consecutive elements.

LC1004.input: Read n and nonnegative k, then n binary values. Print the longest window with at most k zeros.

LC209.input: Read n and a positive target, then n positive integers. Print the shortest window with sum at least target, or 0.

LC1518.input: Read full bottle count and exchange rate (at least 2). Print total bottles drunk.

LC1608.input: Read n and n nonnegative integers. Print x if exactly x elements are at least x, otherwise -1.

LC125.input: Read one ASCII line. Ignore non-alphanumeric characters and case; print true or false for palindrome.

LC9.input: Read a signed 32-bit integer. Print true if its decimal representation is a palindrome, otherwise false.

LC1295.input: Read n followed by n positive integers. Print how many have an even number of decimal digits.

LC977.input: Read n and a sorted array of n integers. Print squares in nondecreasing order.

LC242.input: Read two lowercase English strings, one per line. Print true or false for anagrams.

LC283.input: Read n and n integers. Move zeros to the end while preserving nonzero order. Print the changed array.

DP01.input: Read n from 0 through 90. Print ways to climb n steps using moves of 1 or 2 steps. There is one empty way for n=0.

DP02.input: Read coin count n and amount (0 through 10000), then n positive coin values. Print minimum coins with unlimited reuse, or -1.

DP03.input: Read two ASCII strings on separate lines, at most 1000 characters each. Print the longest common subsequence length.

ADV01.input: Read a line of parentheses and print the longest balanced substring length.
